blocs.texte: Welcome to School Radio. | Today Mia tells us about her day.
I get up at seven o'clock, but I don't have breakfast immediately. | First I get dressed. | I have breakfast at twenty past seven, and I go to school at quarter to eight.
No. | I ride my bicycle. | My friend Noah walks because he lives next to the school.
On Mondays I play the guitar. | On Wednesdays I go swimming, and on Fridays I go to the cinema with my cousin.
Do you do your homework in the evening?
Usually, yes. | I start at half past six. | But on Fridays I do it in the afternoon.
What do you do before bed?
I read a book. | I never play computer games late at night.
